protocol.model_identity_limit: Mutable alias, not fixed weights or verified training cutoff
protocol.comparison: Only B/C newly generated together; old A reused at user request. C differs from B only by a publication-time index.
protocol.role_block:
Belief update instruction:
Your previous survey records the belief you formed last month using the information you had at that time. Treat it as the starting point for your current view. The forecast window has now advanced by one month. Consider whether more recent information warrants keeping or revising that view; keeping it is allowed, revising it is allowed, and no fixed amount of adjustment is required.
protocol.primary_contrast: dated_information minus new_wording on cross-section W1
guardrails: center MAE and delta W1 point values must not worsen for an overall candidate
at least 99% generated questionnaires structurally valid and scorable
protocol.candidate_gate: Primary W1 paired-person upper 95% bound < 0; center MAE and delta W1 points no worse; new scorable fraction >=99%. Not overall project success.
protocol.mechanism_check: Within-month slope on own prior mean, across-person IQR, rank correlation; do not treat a slope as an identified psychological weight.
protocol.aggregation: Each month/repeat separately, equal cell average; Q9 headline-style center is median of individually fitted density means, not a nationwide headline.
protocol.intervals: 2000 paired-person resamples within month, both generations together; 4-month resampling sensitivity; seed 20261015
protocol.truth_isolation: No new sampling. Read only userid/date/survey_date for past-date lookup; current answers/weights confined to evaluation sidecar.
limits: Four previously inspected development periods; no independent holdout claim.
Returners with actual private past answers and retrospective synthetic P; not real-time B.
2020Q4 CE proxy for 2020-04 is retrospective, not a PIT input.
Engine seeds do not imply a seeded or deterministic API generation.
Reused A is an earlier batch; apparent wording gain cannot exclude batch drift.
Publication-time tags do not establish real attention or information acquisition.

protocol.exploratory_contrast: new_wording minus reused_A; contains batch/time drift and is not a clean contemporaneous wording effect
protocol.date_boundary: Prior survey calendar day, New York release dates; same-day unknown response time is ambiguous. No actual prior response date sent.
protocol.support: Same truth-scorable person-generations with all three A/B/C answers, plus explicit failure coverage.

kernel_migration.equivalence_check: 3,741 sealed holdout rows recomputed; zero per-field difference

scorer.approximation_notice: Research approximation of the Armantier et al. (2017) Appendix C generalized-beta fit, selected on a preregistered holdout; not the official FRBNY implementation. The same algorithm scores real and simulated questionnaires; differences from official headline values are reported separately.

exploratory_batch_limit: Old A is from an earlier batch. Resampling people cannot quantify or remove provider/batch drift.
interval_scope: Conditional on four selected months; within-month person pairing preserves repeated generations; month-level sensitivity has only four clusters; not nationwide inference.
